title: Yellow Turmeric Australian Lamb Skewers
description: Charred and juicy lamb skewers featuring turmeric and a mirepoix base, perfect for a low-sodium Australian dinner
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together turmeric powder, olive oil, lemon juice, and garlic
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and cooked through
Meanwhile, heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery to the skillet and cook until tender
Serve the lamb skewers with the mirepoix base
Garnish with fresh parsley and lemon wedges, if desired
